title: EXP-001106 scalar fixture scope correction
question: Does the finite Q3 actual-number-moment package EXP-001106 use the full canonical eight-component onsite system or only a scalar component fixture?
method: Read the EXP-001106 Hamiltonian implementation and finite fixture dimensions.
Compare its scalar q,p onsite and scalar bond terms with the current R-167 authority, which specifies an eight-component Q3 onsite/bond system.
Separate the validity of the finite scalar Markov audit from any claim about the full canonical Q3 component space.
finding: EXP-001106 constructs a finite scalar oscillator at each lattice site: one q, one p, scalar q^4 onsite interaction, and scalar bond differences. The canonical R-167 Q3 route is eight-component, with vector q_x and p_x and full component-coupled onsite/bond structure. Therefore the EXP-001106 primary/independent/integrated results remain valid for their declared scalar component fixture, but they are not a full eight-component Q3 state theorem. The phrase actual finite Q3 is corrected to actual finite scalar-component Q3 proxy in the scope boundary; an eight-component number-moment/domain package remains a separate gate.
decision_reason: Append-only scope correction prevents a scalar component audit from being promoted to the canonical eight-component Q3 parent. No numerical row, Lean result, or finite Markov identity is withdrawn.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing scope correction. The corrected scalar fixture does not establish the full eight-component onsite energy-to-number form inequality, full Q3 source/volume/history uniformity, unbounded common-core transfer, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
